channel.title: The Argo: the house of 0xca4d811c
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Alkides #35 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). T
item.description: Alkides #35 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Glauklaos #6842 of the House of Echion fell (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)).
item.description: Glauklaos #6842 of the House of Echion fell (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Asteia #7076 the Twice-Born and Antimmedes #7213 the Avenger fell in love in the Reef. The
item.description: Asteia #7076 the Twice-Born and Antimmedes #7213 the Avenger fell in love in the Reef. The Gorgonides pretend not to notice. Asteia has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Hermkles #4868 and Chrysdoros #9690 sowed a child in Bear Mountain: Aststratos Hermshlides
item.description: Hermkles #4868 and Chrysdoros #9690 sowed a child in Bear Mountain: Aststratos Hermshlides ~1401. A Leaf, born to bone.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Krat
item.description: Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Kratides Antimnikides ~501. The Leaf stood at the door and was asked its name.

item.title: Chrysmenes #1758 and Euion #5019 sowed a child in the Field of Ares: Poldoto Chrysmenides
item.description: Chrysmenes #1758 and Euion #5019 sowed a child in the Field of Ares: Poldoto Chrysmenides ~1342. A Leaf, born to bone.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Archides #6587 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Archides #6587 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Archides is an initiate, and came back remembering.

item.title: Heard in the Field of Ares, from Kratstratos #145 the Twice-Born: "They say the field at I
item.description: Heard in the Field of Ares, from Kratstratos #145 the Twice-Born: "They say the field at Iolcus ran with marrow. The augurs say it was foretold. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it."

item.title: A child for the House of Chthonius: Chthonchrates Dordotides ~1321, born to Dordotos #5279
item.description: A child for the House of Chthonius: Chthonchrates Dordotides ~1321, born to Dordotos #5279 and Kratkles #9397. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.title: A child for the Anthemoessans: Lychchrates Ersides ~1239, born to Ersion #5758 the Blood-h
item.description: A child for the Anthemoessans: Lychchrates Ersides ~1239, born to Ersion #5758 the Blood-handed and Phillaos #7657. It will grow old; its parents will not.
